title: Director of Protective Operations and Logistics
text:
**Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.**

### **Job Description:**

Director, Executive Protection, Protective Operations and Logistics

The Role:

As the Director of Protective Operations and Logistics within the Executive Protection team, you will be responsible for executive protection program management and logistical planning, including staffing, scheduling*,* protective transportation operations, support request vetting and assessment, training administration, and oversight of the TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program. Reporting to the Head of Executive Protection, you will provide operational leadership, program oversight, and subject matter expertise on executive protection and protective operations matters. You willbe responsible for ensuring the effective execution of day-to-day protective operations while supporting the continued enhancement of the firm's executive protection capabilities. The position requires close collaboration with Global Security Operations, the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), Travel Security, and key internal and external partners to implement and support Fidelity's executive protection strategy. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational, leadership, and relationship-management skills, as well as the ability to balance competing priorities while delivering consistent, discreet, and service-oriented experience for Fidelity's senior leadership.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

* 7-10 years of experience protecting C-suite executives, board members, and/or government officials in complex, dynamic, and globally distributed operating environments within corporate, government, military, or law enforcement settings.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple workstreams
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, security professionals, and external stakeholders
* Extensive knowledge of executive protection operations, including protective advances, travel security, transportation security, venue assessment, route planning and protective operations logistics.
* Expertise in assessing, prioritizing, and coordinating executive support requests while balancing risk, resource requirements, and business priorities.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required and operate effectively in dynamic, rapidly changing, and high-pressure environments.
* Strong understanding of TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program requirements, administration, compliance, certifications, and operational integration; the ability to obtain and maintain ASO certification is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage executive protection staffing models, personnel scheduling, resource allocation, and operational readiness across multiple locations and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, develop, and build high-performing teams while fostering a culture of professionalism, accountability, discretion, and service excellence.
* Experience coordinating and supporting executive travel, special events, corporate meetings, and other high-visibility engagements requiring detailed planning and collaboration.
* Experience managing executive transportation programs, including vehicle operations, driver standards, fleet utilization, and transportation security protocols.
* Experience developing and managing executive protection training programs, operational exercises, performance standards, readiness assessments, and professional development initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree is preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Relevant professional certifications such as CTM, CPP, PSP, ASIS Executive Protection Professional (EPP), TSA ASO, or other intelligence, investigation, or executive protection credentials are a plus.
* undefined

The Purpose of Your Role

 

* Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of executive protection programs that ensure the safety, privacy, and operational effectiveness of Fidelity's executive leadership.
* Manage the day-to-day administration and logistical support of executive protection operations, including staffing, scheduling, executive travel, protective transportation, training, and resource allocation.
* Provide operational leadership and oversight for executive protection program management, ensuring consistent service delivery, operational readiness, and alignment with organizational priorities.
* Serve as a trusted partner to executive stakeholders by delivering responsive, discreet, and customer-focused protective services in support of business activities and executive requirements.
* Oversee the planning and coordination of executive travel, special events, site visits, and high-profile engagements, ensuring appropriate protective measures and logistical support are in place.
* Manage and enhance the TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program, executive transportation services, training initiatives, and other core executive protection capabilities.
* Serve as a trusted security advisor to senior executives, providing strategic guidance, risk-based recommendations, and executive-level briefings on protective operations, emerging threats, and security-related matters.

The Team

The Executive Protection team is part of the broader Protective Services team, which in turn is part of Fidelity’s Global Security team. The Executive Protection team is a highly valued team dedicated to the protection of the firm’s executive leadership and events.

Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model 
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

The base salary range for this position is $95,000-186,000 USD per year.

Placement in the range will vary based on job responsibilities and scope, geographic location, candidate’s relevant experience, and other factors.

Base salary is only part of the total compensation package. Depending on the position and eligibility requirements, the offer package may also include bonus or other variable compensation.

We offer a wide range of benefits to meet your evolving needs and help you live your best life at work and at home. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage and emotional well-being support, market-leading retirement, generous paid time off and parental leave, charitable giving employee match program, and educational assistance including student loan repayment, tuition reimbursement, and learning resources to develop your career.
